## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs"` pass
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Docs changed? `pnpm site:build` run and the pages committed
- [ ] User-facing change? An entry under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No secrets, and no real phone numbers in code, tests or logs
- [ ] User-facing strings go through the locale files, not hardcoded English
